title: ONLINE APPLICATION FOR POSTS OF GROUP-D
text:
KEY LINES:
 HOW TO APPLY 

FULL TEXT:
Gauhati High Court Recruitment. 
 GAUHATI HIGH COURT 
 AIZWAL BENCH 
 AIZWAL, MIZORAM 
 ONLINE APPLICATION FOR GROUP-D POSTS AT THE AIZAWL BENCH OF THE GAUHATI HIGH COURT, 2026. 
 HOW TO APPLY 
 INSTRUCTIONS 
 PHASE 1. 
 TO REGISTER PROVISIONALLY AS AN APPLICANT CLICK HERE -> 
 New Registration 
 PHASE 2. 
 IF ALREADY REGISTERED PROVISIONALY, TO PROVIDE DETAILS OF THE CANDIDATE CLICK HERE -> 
 Update Candidate Details 
 PHASE 3. 
 TO UPLOAD PASSPORT PHOTOGRAPH AND SIGNATURE IMAGE AND TO POST THE CANDIDATURE FOR THE EXAMINATION, CLICK HERE -> 
 Upload Photograph & Signature 
 PHASE 4 
 TO ACCESS ACKNOWLEDGEMENT CARD, ADMIT CARD ETC., CLICK HERE -> 
 ACCESS CANDIDATE HOME
